# SPECIFICATION: REWARDS EARNING RULES DISPLAY

## CURRENT STATE SUMMARY:
Today, reward points are earned automatically based on pre-defined rules (accelerated, standard, or exclusion) at transaction presentment, but customers are not shown why they received a specific cashback rate. Operations teams manually handle exceptions and negative balance scenarios, while customers can only see earned points without transparency into the earning logic applied to each transaction.

---

## SCOPE:

### IN SCOPE:
- Display of earning rule applied to each transaction (accelerated/standard/exclusion)
- Cashback rate percentage shown on transaction detail screen
- Reason code display explaining why specific rate was applied
- MCC-based exclusion messaging
- Accelerated rewards cap status visibility
- Transaction-level earning breakdown in rewards history

### OUT OF SCOPE:
- Modification of existing earning rule engine logic — backend calculation rules remain unchanged per SOP
- Predictive earning estimates for future transactions — requires merchant intelligence not yet available
- Personalized earning recommendations based on spending patterns — deferred to rewards optimization phase 2
- Real-time earning rule changes by customer — business rules are centrally managed
- Historical transaction re-categorization — applies only to transactions post-release

---

## FUNCTIONAL USE CASES:

### Use Case 1: View Accelerated Rewards Earning Explanation (Happy Path)
**Actor:** PIXEL credit card customer

**Precondition:** 
- Customer has completed a transaction at an accelerated rewards merchant
- Transaction has reached presentment stage
- Reward points have been credited to account

**User Story:** As a PIXEL cardholder, I want to see why I earned 5X rewards on my recent purchase so that I understand which merchants give me bonus cashback and can optimize future spending.

**Steps:**
1. Customer navigates to transaction history on PIXEL app home screen
2. Customer taps on specific transaction showing reward points earned
3. System displays transaction detail screen with rewards earning breakdown section
4. Customer views earning rule badge ("5X Accelerated Rewards"), cashback percentage (2.5%), and merchant category explanation
5. Customer taps "Why did I earn this?" info icon
6. System displays bottom sheet explaining: "This merchant is part of our accelerated rewards program. You earned 5X points (2.5% cashback) on this ₹2,000 purchase = 250 reward points. Accelerated rewards cap: 15,000 points used this month out of 20,000 limit."

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given a transaction with accelerated rewards applied, when customer views transaction detail, then earning rule badge displays "5X Accelerated" with green highlight
- Given customer taps info icon on rewards earning section, when bottom sheet opens, then it shows: earning multiplier, cashback percentage, points earned calculation, and current cap utilization with progress bar
- Given accelerated rewards cap is reached, when customer views subsequent accelerated merchant transaction, then badge shows "1X Standard" with explanation "Monthly accelerated rewards limit reached on [date]. This transaction earned standard rate."

**Failure State AC:**
- Given rewards calculation is pending/delayed, when customer views transaction within 2 hours of presentment, then show "Rewards processing" status with estimated completion time instead of earning rule
- Given merchant categorization data is missing, when system cannot determine earning rule, then display "Standard rewards applied" as default with generic 1X messaging

**Priority:** P0

---

### Use Case 2: View Exclusion Category Transaction (Edge Case)
**Actor:** PIXEL credit card customer

**Precondition:**
- Customer has completed transaction at excluded merchant category (fuel/wallet load)
- Transaction has settled but earned 0 reward points
- Customer expects rewards but none were credited

**User Story:** As a PIXEL cardholder, I want to understand why I didn't earn rewards on a specific transaction so that I don't raise unnecessary support tickets and know which purchases don't qualify.

**Steps:**
1. Customer notices transaction in history shows "0 points earned"
2. Customer taps on transaction to view details
3. System displays transaction detail with rewards section showing "No rewards earned" badge in grey
4. Customer taps "Why no rewards?" link
5. System displays bottom sheet: "Fuel purchases are excluded from rewards earning per program terms. Categories excluded: Fuel (MCC 5541, 5542), Wallet loads (MCC 6540), Utility bills (MCC 4900). View full exclusion list."
6. Customer taps "View full exclusion list" to see complete MCC exclusion table

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given transaction MCC matches exclusion list, when customer views transaction detail, then rewards section displays "Excluded category" badge with grey styling and 0 points
- Given customer taps "Why no rewards?" on excluded transaction, when bottom sheet opens, then it shows: specific exclusion reason, MCC code, category name, and link to full T&C
- Given customer views exclusion list, when modal opens, then display all excluded MCCs grouped by category (Fuel, Wallets, Utilities, Cash Advance) with merchant examples for each

**Failure State AC:**
- Given MCC mapping service is unavailable, when system cannot determine exclusion reason, then display generic message "This transaction did not qualify for rewards. Contact support for details" with support CTA
- Given transaction is under dispute/chargeback, when customer views details, then show "Rewards on hold pending transaction resolution" instead of exclusion messaging

**Priority:** P0

---

### Use Case 3: Rewards Reversal Due to Refund (Failure/Exception Case)
**Actor:** PIXEL credit card customer

**Precondition:**
- Customer previously earned accelerated rewards on a purchase
- Merchant has processed full/partial refund
- Reward points have been reversed creating negative balance scenario

**User Story:** As a PIXEL cardholder, I want to see why reward points were deducted from my account so that I understand the reversal is linked to my refunded purchase and not a system error.

**Steps:**
1. Customer receives push notification: "Reward points adjusted due to transaction refund"
2. Customer opens rewards history section from notification
3. System displays rewards transaction log with reversal entry showing negative points
4. Customer taps on reversal entry
5. System displays reversal detail screen showing: original transaction details, original points earned (250 points), refund amount (₹2,000), points reversed (-250 points), original earning rule applied (5X Accelerated), current reward balance
6. If balance is negative, system displays warning: "Your reward balance is negative. This will be adjusted against future earnings or billed after 2 statement cycles if balance remains negative."

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given merchant refund is processed, when reward reversal occurs, then customer receives push notification within 1 hour with reversal amount and linked transaction reference
- Given customer views reversal transaction detail, when screen loads, then it displays: original transaction date/merchant, original earning rule and points, refund amount, reversed points with negative sign, and link to original transaction
- Given reward balance becomes negative after reversal, when customer views rewards dashboard, then display prominent alert banner: "Negative balance: -150 points. Will auto-adjust from future earnings or bill on [date] if not cleared" with countdown to billing date

**Failure State AC:**
- Given reversal cannot be linked to original transaction (orphaned reversal), when customer views detail, then show "Points adjusted - contact support for details" with support ticket creation CTA and transaction reference number
- Given system fails to calculate billing date for negative balance, when customer views alert, then show "Negative balance will be billed per program terms" without specific date and log error for ops team review

**Priority:** P1

---

## NON-FUNCTIONAL USE CASES:

### Performance:
- **Transaction detail screen load time:** Rewards earning rule data must load within 800ms of transaction detail screen render
  - **Acceptance:** 95th percentile load time ≤800ms measured via zchs_rewards_rule_load_time event; fallback to cached earning rule if API timeout >1.5s

- **Rewards history pagination:** Rewards transaction log must support infinite scroll with 50 transactions per page load completing in <500ms
  - **Acceptance:** Page load time ≤500ms for 95% of requests; implement virtual scrolling for lists >200 items

### Security:
- **Earning rule configuration access:** Reward earning rules and MCC mappings must not be exposed in client-side code or API responses beyond what's needed for display
  - **Acceptance:** API returns only applied rule name, rate, and display text; full rule logic remains server-side; security audit confirms no rule engine exposure

- **PII in instrumentation:** Reward earning events must not log merchant names, transaction amounts, or identifiable purchase details
  - **Acceptance:** All instrumentation events use merchant category codes, anonymized transaction IDs, and bucketed amount ranges only

### Accessibility:
- **Screen reader support:** All earning rule badges, info icons, and bottom sheets must be fully navigable via TalkBack/VoiceOver
  - **Acceptance:** Accessibility audit passes with 0 critical issues; all interactive elements have descriptive labels; earning calculations are announced in logical order

- **Color contrast:** Earning rule badges (accelerated/standard/exclusion) must meet WCAG AA contrast ratio of 4.5:1
  - **Acceptance:** Automated contrast checker passes for all badge variants; user testing with visually impaired users confirms readability

### Reliability:
- **Graceful degradation:** If earning rule service is unavailable, transaction details must still display with generic rewards messaging
  - **Acceptance:** Circuit breaker trips after 3 consecutive failures; fallback displays "Rewards earned per program terms" with cached rate if available; ops alert triggered

- **Data consistency:** Earning rule displayed must match actual points credited within 5-minute reconciliation window
  - **Acceptance:** Automated reconciliation job runs every 5 minutes comparing displayed rules vs. actual credits; discrepancy rate <0.1%; alerts for mismatches

---

## METRICS IMPACT:

### Metric 1: Rewards-related support tickets
- **Current baseline:** Unknown — check with customer support analytics team for baseline ticket volume tagged "rewards inquiry" or "cashback question"
- **Expected impact:** 25-35% reduction in rewards explanation tickets within 60 days post-launch
- **Owner:** Customer Support Operations team

### Metric 2: Rewards redemption rate
- **Current baseline:** Unknown — check with rewards analytics for current monthly redemption rate (points redeemed / points earned)
- **Expected impact:** 8-12% increase in redemption rate as transparency drives engagement and understanding of earning potential
- **Owner:** Rewards Product team

### Metric 3: Accelerated merchant repeat transaction rate
- **Current baseline:** Unknown — check with transaction analytics for repeat purchase rate at accelerated merchants vs. standard merchants
- **Expected impact:** 15-20% increase in repeat transactions at accelerated merchants as customers become aware of bonus earning opportunities
- **Owner:** Growth/Engagement team

---

## NEW METRICS TO TRACK:

### Metric 1: Earning rule info icon tap rate
- **Definition:** (Number of users tapping "Why did I earn this?" info icon / Total users viewing transaction details with rewards) × 100
- **Target:** 35-45% tap rate indicating healthy curiosity and engagement with earning transparency
- **Owner:** Product Analytics team

### Metric 2: Exclusion category view rate
- **Definition:** (Number of users viewing "Why no rewards?" explanation on excluded transactions / Total excluded transactions viewed) × 100
- **Target:** >60% view rate to ensure customers understand exclusions before contacting support
- **Owner:** Product Analytics team

### Metric 3: Negative balance alert acknowledgment rate
- **Definition:** (Number of users who view negative balance alert detail / Total users with negative balance) × 100
- **Target:** >80% acknowledgment within 48 hours of balance going negative to minimize billing surprises
- **Owner:** Rewards Operations team

### Metric 4: Earning rule display accuracy
- **Definition:** (Transactions where displayed earning rule matches actual credited rule / Total transactions with earning rule displayed) × 100
- **Target:** >99.5% accuracy; any discrepancy triggers immediate investigation
- **Owner:** Engineering/QA team

---

## REPORTS & EXTRACTS IMPACT:

### New reports needed:
- **Earning Rule Display Audit Report:** Daily reconciliation comparing displayed earning rules vs. actual reward credits by transaction; flags discrepancies >0.1% for ops review
- **Exclusion Category Performance Report:** Weekly report showing transaction volume and GMV by excluded MCC category; helps business assess exclusion policy impact
- **Negative Balance Aging Report:** Daily report of accounts with negative reward balance showing: days in negative status, projected billing date, balance amount; feeds auto-billing process

### Existing reports affected:
- **Monthly Rewards Provision Report:** Add new column "Earning Rule Display Errors" showing count of transactions where displayed rule didn't match credited rule
- **Customer Support Ticket Report:** Add filter for "Rewards Transparency" category to track tickets related to earning rule questions post-launch
- **Rewards Reconciliation Report:** Enhance to include earning rule metadata (accelerated/standard/exclusion flag) for each transaction line item

### Reconciliation requirements:
- **Earning rule display vs. actual credits:** Must reconcile within 5-minute window; discrepancies logged to exception queue for manual review
- **Accelerated rewards cap tracking:** Displayed cap utilization must match backend cap consumption calculation; reconciled at end of each statement cycle
- **Reversal linking:** Each displayed reversal must link to original earning transaction; orphaned reversals flagged for ops investigation

### Data extract requirements:
- **Analytics team:** Daily extract of earning rule display events (rule type, merchant category, transaction amount bucket, user engagement) for funnel analysis
- **Finance team:** Monthly extract of excluded transaction volume and GMV by MCC for revenue impact assessment
- **Compliance team:** Quarterly extract of earning rule display accuracy metrics and customer complaint correlation for regulatory reporting

---

## INSTRUMENTATION REQUIREMENTS:

### Event 1: zcrw_earning_rule_viewed
- **Trigger:** When transaction detail screen loads and earning rule section is rendered to user
- **Properties:**
  - `transactionId` (string): Anonymized transaction reference
  - `earningRuleType` (string): "accelerated" | "standard" | "exclusion"
  - `rewardMultiplier` (string): "1X" | "2X" | "5X" | "10X" | "0X"
  - `merchantCategory` (string): MCC category name (e.g., "dining", "fuel", "grocery")
  - `pointsEarned` (integer): Actual points credited (0 for exclusions)
  - `capStatus` (string): "within_limit" | "cap_reached" | "no_cap" | "unknown"
- **Purpose:** Measure which earning rule types customers view most; identify engagement patterns by merchant category

### Event 2: zcrw_earning_explanation_interacted
- **Trigger:** When user taps "Why did I earn this?" info icon or "Why no rewards?" link
- **Properties:**
  - `transactionId` (string): Anonymized transaction reference
  - `earningRuleType` (string): "accelerated" | "standard" | "exclusion"
  - `interactionType` (string): "info_icon_tap" | "no_rewards_link_tap" | "view_exclusion_list"
  - `capUtilization` (integer): Percentage of accelerated cap used (0-100, null if not applicable)
  - `timeOnScreen` (integer): Seconds user spent viewing explanation bottom sheet
- **Purpose:** Measure customer curiosity and comprehension; identify which earning scenarios require more explanation

### Event 3: zcrw_exclusion_list_viewed
- **Trigger:** When user opens full exclusion category list modal from transaction detail
- **Properties:**
  - `entryPoint` (string): "transaction_detail" | "rewards_faq" | "support_article"
  - `excludedMccViewed` (array): List of MCC categories user scrolled through (e.g., ["fuel", "wallets"])
  - `listScrollDepth` (integer): Percentage of list scrolled (0-100)
  - `tcLinkTapped` (boolean): Whether user tapped "View full T&C" link
- **Purpose:** Understand which exclusion categories customers investigate most; optimize exclusion communication

### Event 4: zcrw_negative_balance_alert_viewed
- **Trigger:** When negative balance alert banner is displayed on rewards dashboard or transaction detail
- **Properties:**
  - `negativeBalanceAmount` (integer): Absolute value of negative points (bucketed: 0-100, 101-500, 501-1000, 1000+)
  - `daysUntilBilling` (integer): Days remaining before auto-billing (bucketed: 0-7, 8-30, 31-60, 60+)
  - `alertType` (string): "banner" | "modal" | "push_notification"
  - `linkedReversalCount` (integer): Number
